0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-1, 3rd in the Pacific and 7th in the West, 1.5 games back in the division) host the Lakers (3-0, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) after a loss in their last game, and they are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The Clippers are 1-0 at home and 0-1 on the road, while the Lakers have won three straight, going 2-0 at home and 1-0 on the road. The 2026-27 season series has the Clippers trailing 0-1 after the Lakers won 125-117 in Los Angeles, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
